rationaleNote: One sheet: the lesson's bridging method (sc-002, word for word) pinned to 48 + 25 drawn as one number line, kept for the next lesson, subtract two 2-digit numbers, where the teacher points back at partitioning the second number and stopping at the ten. Cut: the non-bridging steps (sc-002 already covers them), the tens-as-ones and lost-ones misconceptions (the jumps to 70 then +3 show the correction), the sticky fact and the two vocabulary words, none of which needs its own sheet.

items.label: Step 1
items.text: {{Partition}} the second number into tens and ones.

items.label: Step 2
items.text: Count on the <<tens>> from the first number.

items.label: Step 3
items.text: Will the ones go past the next ten? If not, add them.

items.label: Step 4
items.text: If they will, add enough ones to <<reach the next ten>>.

items.label: Step 5
items.text: Add the ones that are left.
